overview.overview:
Montana is expected to back the Republican nominee in 2028 by a wide margin. The central projection is a Republican lead of about 14.5 points, with a plausible range from roughly 6 to 24 points. Montana voted Republican by 16.4 points in 2020 and by 19.9 points in 2024, and it leans about 19 points more Republican than the nation as a whole.

No state polls or recent headlines are included for Montana, so the outlook rests mainly on past results, its partisan lean, and the broader national environment. Its four electoral votes are very unlikely to decide the national outcome. The 2026 Senate figure of -35.9 also points to a large Republican advantage in statewide contests.
overview.watch: A sharp change in the national environment or a strong, well-funded challenger in a statewide race could narrow the gap, though no current data points clearly in that direction.
key_factors: Republican wins by double digits in both 2020 and 2024
A partisan lean about 19 points more Republican than the nation
A large Republican advantage in the 2026 Senate figure
No state polling available to test the projection
